acceptanceCriteria: On a frontier-case failure, conformance/host-lifecycle-v1 reports the Stop hook's stdout, stderr, exit code and elapsed time, and any degradation it named (for example dogfood-event-deadline).

The root cause of the intermittent decision <nil> is identified from that evidence, or the case is shown to be deadline-bound and the harness or the deadline is corrected without weakening the blocking claim.
body: Context: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 candidate da78c1572211a85e6c9944adb98350d69964eb9b (build 358), Claude Code 2.1.267, adapter 0.2.3, darwin/arm64, 2026-10-05. Runbook step hlq-claude-code (`go run ./conformance/host-lifecycle-v1 --host claude-code ...`) reported `case frontier FAIL enrolled incomplete Stop returned decision <nil>`; 8 other cases passed. Candidate 1 (0ae3f88d, build 357, product source identical: only tests and docs differ) passed, and three reruns on da78c157 under load average ~245 all passed. Expected: an enrolled incomplete Stop blocks naming unavailable Frontier authority. Suspected (unconfirmed): the Stop event exceeded dogfoodEventDeadline (cmd/corvint/local_completion_event.go:27, 1600 ms) and failed open. The harness (conformance/host-lifecycle-v1/main.go:859-861) discards the hook output, so the cause cannot be confirmed. Evidence: /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint-release-evidence/1.0.0-rc.2-da78c157/hlq-claude-code.{txt,out}.
title: Host lifecycle claude-code frontier case intermittently gets no Stop decision and keeps no hook output
